planning_notes: Confirmed board: arduino:avr:uno. Confirmed wired pins: A0 (analog input) and D2 (digital input). No other device/port objects are created.

Serial requirement is 'each second output A0 potentiometer value and D2 button state'. Implemented as one serial channel gated by a single 1 Hz boolean trigger so both values are reported together on each gate event.
Pin polarity for D2 button is unspecified in provided facts; model convention assumes digital_input model is true when pressed, with no extra active-low inversion applied beyond catalog defaults.
Analog input uses catalog default electrical scaling; no explicit scale/offset calibration was provided, so the reported unit is assumed to be raw adc_count.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Potentiometer value to be reported over serial (raw ADC-based model value)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Button state to be reported over serial (model true when pressed)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Actual delta since previous control step for 1 Hz serial reporting scheduling

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Gate serial output once per second (1 Hz) with the latest A0 potentiometer value and D2 button state

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Reported potentiometer A0 reading (model ADC-based value)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_1
interfaces.meaning: Reported D2 button pressed state (model true when pressed)
